sb.name: Draconic Spirit
sb.ac: 14 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison (Chromatic and Metallic only); force, necrotic, psychic, radiant, thunder (Gem only)
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12
sb.languages: Draconic, understands the languages you speak

traits.name: Shared Resistances
traits.desc: When you summon the dragon, choose one of its damage resistances. You have resistance to the chosen damage type until the spell ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon uses its Breath Weapon, and it makes a number of Bite and Claw attacks equal to half the spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Bite and Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 4 + the spell's level piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon
actions.desc: The dragon exhales a stream of multicolored energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 damage of your choice of a damage type this dragon has resistance to on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
